nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Documents the environment variables for application behavior, browser origins, AI provider credentials and models, local or compatible endpoints, GitHub access, and request timeouts.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contributor guide covering valuable contribution areas, local backend and frontend setup, quality checks, secret handling, and pull-request expectations across five sections.

nodes.name: IDEA_GUIDE.md
nodes.summary: Founder-facing guide for writing a strong validation brief, choosing research depth, handling regional validation, running the engine, and turning evidence into a decision.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive project overview and quick-start guide covering the validation workflow, CLI and web usage, model providers, scoring, research accuracy, architecture, development, and safe deployment across eighteen sections.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy explaining private vulnerability reporting expectations and the operator’s responsibility for safe deployment.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Orchestrates backend and frontend containers, exposes the API and web ports, persists analysis data, forwards provider configuration, adds an API health check, and starts the frontend after the backend.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines two Compose services and a persistent named volume, with the frontend depending on the backend and the backend guarded by an HTTP health check.

nodes.name: start_web.bat
nodes.summary: Windows development launcher that checks prerequisites, provisions backend and frontend dependencies, creates data directories, starts both servers in separate command windows, and opens the web interface.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a linear Batch workflow with errorlevel checks and generated temporary helper scripts; it defines no callable labels.

nodes.name: start_web.sh
nodes.summary: Unix development launcher that checks prerequisites, provisions dependencies and data storage, starts backend and frontend processes, opens the browser when supported, and cleans up child processes on termination.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses fail-fast Bash execution, background process IDs, and signal trapping for coordinated shutdown; it defines no named functions.
